end_of_life_limits._note: SIH26054 does not define end-of-life. Every limit below is chosen by this project, from the engine's own published/derived operating envelope, and is stated in physical units so it can be argued with, replaced by an operator's own maintenance manual figures, or rejected outright. Health-index percentages are DERIVED from these limits, never the other way round.

oil_system.criterion: Oil pressure at or below limit while at rated RPM
oil_system.operator_text: oil pressure projected to reach {limit} bar
oil_system.source: nominal_operating_parameters.oil_pressure_min_safe_bar in this file; the minimum-safe figure the sensor model and fault injector are built around. Below it, hydrodynamic bearing film cannot be assumed at rated speed.

cylinders.criterion: CHT above max continuous, or EGT spread across cylinders beyond margin
cylinders.operator_text: cylinder head temperature projected to reach {limit} C
cylinders.source: nominal_operating_parameters.cht_max_continuous_celsius (220 C) in this file. The 90 C EGT-spread margin is this project's own: it is roughly twice the largest spread seen across the healthy training sorties, so it sits outside normal build and instrument scatter without waiting for the 920 C alarm.

turbo_boost.criterion: Manifold pressure deficit below the rated-boost schedule
turbo_boost.operator_text: manifold pressure projected to fall {limit} bar below rated boost
turbo_boost.source: Derived from altitude_power_derating in this file: 0.35 bar is the boost step between the 20,000 ft (2.10 bar / 150 HP) and 30,000 ft (1.65 bar / 110 HP) rows scaled to one derating band. A deficit that size costs a full altitude band of power, which is the point the airframe can no longer hold its ceiling.

vibration.operator_text: 2X order vibration projected to reach {limit} g
vibration.source: This project's own figure, set between nominal (1.2 g rms) and the 4.5 g rms alarm in nominal_operating_parameters. The 2X order is the bearing-wear signature the MVEM generates; 2.5 g is where it dominates the 1X fundamental. Replace with the airframe's published vibration survey when one exists.

electrical.criterion: Bus voltage below limit under full avionics load
electrical.operator_text: bus voltage projected to fall to {limit} V
electrical.source: MIL-STD-704F steady-state lower limit for a 28 VDC bus is 22.0 V; 24.0 V is this project's margin above it, so the projection reaches the operator before flight-critical avionics reach their own undervoltage cutouts.
